description: Identify the chemical and physical properties of water, including its molecular structure, density, and solubility
Analyze the current global water distribution, including freshwater sources, oceans, and ice caps, and their impact on the environment and human societies
Examine the historical context of water usage and management, including ancient civilizations' water systems, historical water-related disasters, and the evolution of water treatment technologies
Investigate the major challenges facing global water security, including water scarcity, pollution, climate change, and their impacts on human health, economy, and ecosystems

Explore future water management strategies, including innovative technologies, sustainable practices, and policy frameworks for ensuring global water security and addressing the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) related to water
